title: Escape60
specs: Rooms designed to feel open and comfortable, not cramped
No age limit but recommend at least one adult for children under 10
No cell phones or photo devices allowed in rooms
Rooms accommodate 6-8 players; some rooms up to 12 for larger groups
includes: Use of lockers for cell phones and devices
gap: Maximum group size per room not explicitly stated for all rooms
blurb: Guests participate in physical, themed escape room games where they solve puzzles using clues and strategy to complete objectives. Most rooms have a 60-minute time limit, except the Friendsgiving diamond room with 75 minutes. Rooms are private for each group and monitored for safety.
extraNote: Cancellation requires 48 hours notice; deposits non-refundable but credited for future use · Credit card hold required for booking · Escape60 location at 1638 10th Ave SW, Calgary
